context_requirements: Expression of the nitric oxide receptor soluble guanylate cyclase (GUCY1A3/GUCY1B3 heterodimer) in the assayed cell line
Presence of a nitric oxide donor or other activator to enable cGMP production; direct stimulants may bypass this but still require the enzyme
cGMP-responsive transcriptional machinery or downstream pathways that can alter gene expression within 6-24 h
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in the 978 landmark genes at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
Shared transcriptional signature across multiple cell lines that is absent in vehicle controls
Evidence of cGMP-dependent gene regulation (e.g., induction of known cGMP-responsive genes) in these lines
